meta.about: What a visitor's browser loads for each theme and element, file by file, and the shared core. Bytes are gzip of each file's source, not minified CDN output; third-party code (lit, mobx) is left out; static imports are followed from haxcms-site-builder, the theme and each element.

core.definition: haxcms-site-builder's static closure plus every module at least 80% of themes load

journeys.note: every page also uses grid-plate; moving between pages of one site keeps what is loaded
